{{Current events|year=2021|month=03|day=12|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Kaduna kidnapping]]
**Thirty students and several staff members are [[kidnap]]ped from a school in [[Kaduna State]], [[Nigeria]], by a group of gunmen. [https://apnews.com/article/world-news-forestry-nigeria-shooting1ce1206015d976eb6d14a1bfa5c642a9 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bulgaria]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Bulgaria]]
*****[[Prime Minister of Bulgaria|Prime Minister]] [[Boyko Borisov]] announces the suspension of the use of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] following the death of a 57-year-old woman from [[Plovdiv]] after she received her dose. [https://www.euractiv.com/section/all/news/bulgaria-suspends-astrazeneca-vaccine-use/ (''Euractiv'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****The [[France|French]] Haute Autorité de Santé approves the use of the single-dose [[Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine|Johnson & Johnson]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2021-03-12/france-approves-j-js-janssen-covid-19-vaccine (''U.S. News & World Report'')]
****[[France]] surpasses four million cases and 90,000 deaths of [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.business-standard.com/article/current-affairs/france-s-covid-tally-top-4-mn-with-25-229-cases-total-deaths-pass-90-000-121031300080_1.html (''Business Standard'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****A [[COVID-19 lockdown in Italy|lockdown]] will start on March 15 and last until April 6 for the [[Italy|Italian]] [[Regions of Italy|regions]] of [[Lombardy]], [[Apulia]], [[Friuli Venezia Giulia]], [[Piedmont]], [[Lazio]], [[Veneto]], [[Emilia Romagna]], and [[Marche]], thereby bringing the total number of regions under lockdown in the country to 11. The [[Trentino|Autonomous Province of Trento]] is also placed under a lockdown, while strict measures are imposed for eight more regions. Between April 3–5, the entire country will be placed under a lockdown. [https://www.ansa.it/sito/notizie/cronaca/2021/03/12/covid-misure-pasqua.-consiglio-dei-ministri-_b70058c2-5440-4fd5-b013-d9dfe3b6b0c1.html (Agenzia Nazionale Stampa Associata)]
****The [[Italian Medicines Agency]] approves the use of the single-dose [[Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine|Johnson & Johnson]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-vaccine-aifa-idUSKBN2B42KS (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belarus]]
****[[Belarus]] reports 1,186 cases of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, bringing the total number of cases to 300,146 cases. [https://eng.belta.by/society/view/belarus-reports-1186-new-covid-19-cases-1243-recoveries-in-past-24-hours-138169-2021/ (Belarusian Telegraph Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]] reports 14,941 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the last 24 hours, which is the highest single-day total this year, and brings the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 2,850,930. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/turkey-logs-highest-daily-rise-in-covid-19-cases-this-year-14395510 (CNA)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Azerbaijan]]
****[[Azerbaijan]] approves general use of the [[Russia]]n [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://finance.yahoo.com/news/azerbaijan-approves-russias-sputnik-v-122258595.html (Yahoo! Finance)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]], [[Variants of SARS-CoV-2]]
****[[Japan]]ese [[Ministry of Health, Labour, and Welfare|health authorities]] reports its first case of a new variant of [[SARS-CoV-2]] in a traveler aged 60s from the [[Philippines]]. The variant is different from the Brazil, South African, and UK variants. [https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2021/03/f490b9d06b6d-new-coronavirus-variant-found-in-traveler-from-philippines-japan.html (Kyodo News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mongolia]]
****[[Mongolia]] receives 14,400 doses of the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] through [[COVAX]] initiative. [https://www.who.int/mongolia/news/detail/-mongolia-welcomes-first-batch-of-covid-19-vaccines-via-covax-facility (World Health Organization)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan]]
****[[Pakistan]] surpasses 600,000 cases of COVID-19. [https://www.geo.tv/latest/339349-pakistans-coronavirus-cases-cross-600000-as-threat-of-third-wave-looms (Geo News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka]], [[501.V2 variant]]
****[[Sri Lanka]] reports its first case of the 501.V2 variant, which originated in [[South Africa]], in a person who travelled from [[Tanzania]] and is currently staying at a [[quarantine]] centre. [http://www.adaderana.lk/news/72233/south-african-variant-of-covid-19-detected-in-sri-lanka (Ada Derana)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] postpones the public [[vaccination]] of [[Prime Minister of Thailand|Prime Minister]] [[Prayut Chan-o-cha]] and his [[Cabinet of Thailand|cabinet]] using the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] following reports of side-effects in some vaccinated people. [https://www.ft.com/content/6cf98c42-f9e3-4d1c-b0fd-f810e70ad459 (''Financial Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Arizona]], [[Lineage P.1]]
****[[Arizona]] reports its first three case of the Lineage P.1 variant, which originated in [[Brazil]]. [https://www.azcentral.com/story/news/local/arizona-health/2021/03/12/az-identifies-3-cases-more-contagious-brazil-variant/4674509001/ (''The Arizona Republic'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)]] 
****[[Lieutenant Governor of New York|New York Lieutenant Governor]] [[Kathy Hochul]] receives a dose of the [[Johnson & Johnson]] [[Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] at [[Catholic Health]] in [[Buffalo, New York|Buffalo]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/videos/news/nation/2021/03/12/new-yorks-lt-governor-receives-covid-19-vaccine/4673301001/ (''USA Today'')]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
****The [[United States]] surpasses 100 million [[COVID-19 vaccine]] doses that have been administered. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/03/12/us-tops-100-million-covid-vaccine-doses-administered-13percent-of-adults-now-fully-vaccinated.html (CNBC)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
***[[Brazil]] reports 85,663 new confirmed cases and 2,216 more deaths from [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], surpassing [[India]] as the country with the second-highest number of cases in the world, and also bringing Brazil's total cases to 11,363,380. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-03-12/brazil-passes-india-for-second-highest-covid-case-toll-in-world (Bloomberg News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]]
***[[Auckland]] returns to alert level 1 and lifts all [[COVID-19]]-related restrictions aside from their [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|face mask]] requirement on [[public transport in New Zealand|public transport]] after no community cases were found. [https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/covid-19-coronavirus-auckland-moves-to-alert-level-1-from-midday-friday-announces-jacinda-ardern/XZEVVUVHC3ASJYF5OYJYN2X6LU/ (''The New Zealand Herald'')]
**The [[World Health Organization]] grants emergency use approval for the single-dose [[Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine|Johnson & Johnson]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]], becoming the third vaccine to be approved after the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|Pfizer]] and [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|Moderna]] vaccines. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/joewalsh/2021/03/12/who-approves-johnson--johnsons-covid-vaccine-as-developing-countries-lag-in-immunizations/ (''Forbes'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Greece–United Kingdom relations]]
**In an interview with Greek newspaper ''[[Ta Nea]]'', [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|UK Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] says Britain is the legitimate and legal owner of the historic 2,500-year-old [[Elgin Marbles]] amid growing calls to [[Elgin_Marbles#Relocation_debate|return the marbles]] to [[Greece]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSKBN2B41RF?il=0 (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Hong Kong national security law]], [[2021 arrests of Hong Kong pro-democracy primaries participants]]
**An upper court in [[Hong Kong]] denies bail for a second time to 11 of the 47 [[defendant]]s in the case, citing national security risks. Among those who were again denied bail are prominent activists and politicians such as [[Leung Kwok-hung]], [[Claudia Mo]], [[Jimmy Sham]], [[Lester Shum]], and [[Fergus Leung]]. The remaining defendants either withdrew their bail application or remain in custody under other circumstances. [https://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/law-and-crime/article/3125152/national-security-law-bail-denied-again-11-47-hong (''South China Morning Post'')]
*Aftermath of the [[killing of George Floyd]]
**The family of [[George Floyd]], the man killed while in [[Minneapolis Police Department|police]] custody last May, settles their lawsuit against the city of [[Minneapolis]] for [[United States dollar|$]]27 million. [https://www.startribune.com/minneapolis-to-pay-record-27-million-to-settle-lawsuit-with-george-floyd-s-family/600033541/ (''Star Tribune'')]
*[[Death of Sarah Everard]]
**A [[Metropolitan Police]] officer is [[criminal charge|charged]] with kidnapping and [[murder in English law|murder]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-london-56331948 (BBC)]
*[[2019 Bolivian political crisis]]
**The Bolivian office of the Prosecutor General issues an arrest order for former interim [[President of Bolivia|President]] [[Jeanine Áñez]], five former members of the national cabinet and the former leadership of the [[Armed Forces of Bolivia|Armed Forces]], accusing them of the crimes of [[sedition]] and [[terrorism]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/mar/12/bolivia-ex-interim-president-jeanine-anez-arrest-warrant (''The Guardian'')]
